name: Build Breaker
author: Brett
description: Everything Brett ever asked for. The requests ledger (request@1): every single ask (builds, addenda, plans, bugs, follow-ups, settings, crew changes), one line each with a status chip, place in line, agent and age; a line opens into his verbatim words, where it lives now (build + step, plan, bug, memory file), queue and agent slot, PR, cost, history, family (addenda, what reversed or replaced it) and hooks (open build / step / PR / bug / plan, jump to queue, open log, talk to agent). Live, with search, filters, sort and group-by; a banner badge counts the open ones and a Home card suggestion lists them. REST, MCP (requests_list, request_get, request_update, request_link) and CLI (requests.mjs). Also the older asks list (build-asks@1) by app, plugin and timeline, and a permanent Build item on every context menu.
